reference_policy: Tree of Savior named directly; no game images stored or provided as image inputs. Only our generated r5_lineup is used as a visual input.

calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a large landscape character lineup, 1536x1024. Match the actual original PC Tree of Savior (IMC Games) in-game character art look as closely as possible. Tree of Savior is the primary visual reference, not a generic watercolor storybook. Four original designs side by side on a plain light ivory background, full bodies uncropped, all in three-quarter view facing screen right: (1) Cookie, female swordsman, shoulder-length light blonde hair, blue tunic, light silver breastplate, red waist sash, brown belt and boots, one-handed straight sword held in her anatomical RIGHT hand; (2) female mage in a purple robe carrying a staff with a blue orb; (3) male archer wearing a green hood and cape over leather clothing, carrying a bow; (4) a small green slime monster. Match the game's delicate faces, slender compact playable-character proportions, fine drawing and richly nuanced hand-painted sprite rendering. Large readable figures with space between them and aligned ground level. Keep costumes original and simple; no copied Tree of Savior characters, class costumes, logos or UI. No text. Avoid glossy gacha illustration, western storybook painting, thick-outlined chibi.

Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is the approved original character design and exact rendering reference. Create a large landscape four-pose character action sheet, 1536x1024, showing ONLY Cookie, the blonde swordswoman at the left of the reference. Preserve exactly her face, shoulder-length light blonde hair, blue tunic, light silver breastplate, red waist sash, brown belt, boots, gloves, sword, costume details and proportions. Render in the actual original PC Tree of Savior character art look, matching the reference's fine drawing and subtle hand-painted colors. Four full-body poses in one evenly spaced horizontal row, same scale, plain light ivory background, all directed screen right in a readable three-quarter view: idle with sword lowered; walking with one foot forward and restrained arm swing; attack wind-up with sword drawn back above her own RIGHT shoulder and torso coiled; attack strike with a decisive forward step and her own RIGHT arm extending the sword towards screen right. In ALL four panels the same anatomical RIGHT hand grips the sword; LEFT hand is empty and balances the body. Show the grip and arm connection clearly, never mirror the character. All swords and feet fully inside their panels, no overlap between figures. Tiny understated labels below the figures exactly 'IDLE', 'WALK', 'WIND-UP', 'STRIKE'. No additional characters, logos, UI, glossy gacha shading, western storybook paint, or thick chibi outlines.
